customManagers.description: Track nginx releases from nginx upstream (github.com/nginx/nginx, release-* tags), NOT from the OpenWrt packages feed, which lags upstream by months. Feeds patches/feeds/packages/101-nginx-track-stable.patch. Renovate bumps PKG_VERSION only; PKG_HASH must be refreshed by hand in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Track the nginx stable branch only: mainline releases (odd minor) are not supported for production use. Raise this bound when adopting a new stable branch, and review upstream's 'Change:' entries before doing so.
Pin telegraf to 1.39.x: minor and major version bumps require verification that they support the Go version shipped with the current OpenWrt version. Patch updates are allowed automatically.
Pin victoria-metrics to 1.142.x: minor and major version bumps require verification that they support the Go version shipped with the current OpenWrt version. Patch updates are allowed automatically.
Pin victoria-logs to 1.50.x: minor and major version bumps require verification that they support the Go version shipped with the current OpenWrt version. Patch updates are allowed automatically.
